scope: Read-only analysis of existing actual live call logs; no new simulation, code execution, or generated artifact edits. Raw code, tool arguments, raw responses and credentials are omitted.
message_indices: Zero-based indices into data.result.call.messages, not transcript display numbers.

findings.conclusion: Actual collection utterances repeatedly differ materially from the already-correct computed collection_say. The node is LLM entry, not TTS. Rendered model requests are absent, so this does not establish an interpolation-engine defect.

c_items is a string containing JSON by description only. Actual extraction emits caller prose, malformed JSON, errors, and a paid claim absent from caller input. This is distinct from incompatible enum validation.

decide.unpack silently replaces malformed JSON with []; proposal with no items then reaches refuse(scope). Live proposal loss therefore advances negotiation/refusal instead of preserving the supplied proposal or asking for clarification.
findings.source: /workflow/nodes/decide/code: unpack, main items extraction, final else/refuse

findings.conclusion: The engine consumes acceptance against its computed offer even when the actual spoken offer differs. PUB13 message70 speaks a card offer for 30 October while its state offers the personal loan for 16 October; the next acceptance leads to a personal-loan read-back for 16 October.

The first-self discard condition was not observed: both completed calls advance from the first confirmation to DOB. Their visible variable tables omit system.conversation, so absence there does not establish absence in code execution.
